content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online with crypto payments means bypassing traditional payment processors that charge high fees and impose restrictions. By utilizing NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction compared to platforms like Gumroad that charge 10%, creators can significantly increase their profits. For example, if you sell a $97 beat and make 100 sales in a month, this difference translates to retaining an additional $921. This model not only enhances profitability but also ensures that creators have full ownership and control over their online business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for selling beats involves a combination of free tools and services that work together seamlessly. Hosting is done through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provide a reliable platform for your website. For backend logic, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle payment processing and order management. When a customer pays using cryptocurrencies, NOWPayments processes the transaction on-chain, delivering your product automatically via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This setup ensures that you maintain full data ownership without relying on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions facing payment processing limitations. Artists selling beats, templates, or courses can leverage this infrastructure to create a sustainable business model without the risk of platform dependency. By embracing crypto payments, creators not only gain lower transaction fees but also the ability to transact with a global audience. This democratizes access to digital sales, empowering creators to take control of their financial futures.
Retain more profits with 0.5% fees compared to 10% on platforms like Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The entire stack consists of several key components: a hosting service (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), a backend processing tool (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), an order management system (Supabase or Google Sheets), a file delivery mechanism (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2), and a payment processor (NOWPayments). Each element plays a crucial role in ensuring that your online store operates smoothly. By integrating these components, you create a robust and efficient ecommerce environment that minimizes overhead and maximizes revenue.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first, choose your hosting solution between GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, then set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Next, configure your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. After that, upload your beats to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. For a comprehensive guide and all necessary templates, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Gain complete ownership of your digital sales infrastructure without ongoing subscriptions.

The Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all necessary blueprints and templates for setting up your online store efficiently. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
